facts.text: The Yagüe Culinary Trust commissioned her tasting menu Nixtamal Suite, later honored with the Teotitlán Hearth Prize.

She sits on the Mixteca Grain Panel, convened by the Yagüe Culinary Trust and chaired by Odilón Serrat.
With Rufina Petriz Loo she leads the admired Seed Ledger Oaxaca, run with Tlacolula Market Cooperative.
She returns yearly to Smoke, Salt, Seed, a series programmed by Casa Nueve with Zapotec Kitchens Collective.
